name: My puppy: Brown Labrador
summary: Step into your mixed reality world and meet your cheerful Brown Labrador! This friendly pup loves treats, toys, and attention. Feed it crunchy biscuits and juicy chicken legs to keep its tail wagging. Toss a ball or toy bone to play together and watch its excitement burst into life. When it calms down, reach out to gently pet its head or give a belly rub—it’ll lean in with pure happiness. Every touch, every snack, and every game strengthens your bond.
